granterChannel.description: Granter/owner’s timeline (direct grant-document revoke lives here).

revoke.description: Granter requests revocation on the grant document. Grantee-document self-revoke uses the existing revoke-request event with grantDocumentId emitted from the grantee document itself.

items.value: granterChannel must be bound to an accountId
granteeDocumentId must be a non-empty string
allowedWorkerAgencyPermissions must be a non-empty array
